$description: Structured representation of the Contera Product Ontology. Derived from context/product.md Section 2. Non-authoritative — see context/manifest.md §7. Markdown wins on any discrepancy. Status values use the epistemic vocabulary defined in context/product.md (DEFINED / WORKING_HYPOTHESIS / UNRESOLVED).

actors.name: Counter Agent
unresolved: specific monetary, override, and communication permissions

actors.name: Yard Associate
unresolved: exact authority to pass/fail equipment or remove equipment from service

actors.name: Fleet Manager
unresolved: exact safety, maintenance, and branch-level override authority

actors.name: Operations Agent
actors.note: Not defined as a chatbot or a particular interface. Capability does not imply authority to exercise it autonomously.
capabilities: identify situations requiring human review or escalation

core_objects.name: Customer
core_objects.definition: A person or organization renting equipment.

core_objects.name: Reservation
core_objects.definition: Future intent to rent equipment or an equipment type.

core_objects.name: Rental
core_objects.definition: An active or historical contractual use of equipment by a customer.

core_objects.name: Location
core_objects.definition: A branch or other operational location where equipment resides or rental activity occurs.

core_objects.name: Inspection
core_objects.definition: A structured assessment of equipment condition.

core_objects.name: Evidence
core_objects.definition: Information supporting an observation, inference, recommendation, or decision. Examples: photos, video, voice observations, notes, meter readings, signatures, inspection records, maintenance records.

core_objects.name: Damage
core_objects.definition: A recorded or suspected physical condition affecting equipment.

core_objects.name: Maintenance Event
core_objects.definition: Maintenance work required, scheduled, recommended, or performed on equipment.

core_objects.name: Payment / Charge
core_objects.definition: A financial transaction or proposed financial transaction associated with a rental or customer.

core_objects.name: Communication
core_objects.definition: A customer or operational communication such as call, SMS, email, or system-generated message.

core_objects.name: Agent Action
core_objects.definition: An observation, recommendation, preparation, or execution performed by the Operations Agent.

core_objects.name: Approval
core_objects.definition: Human authorization associated with an action that requires review before execution.
core_objects.note: Dual status: also an interaction primitive in context/behaviors.md, representing the same underlying concept from the authorization-experience angle. See product.md §2.6.

core_objects.name: Equipment Turnaround Requirement
core_objects.definition: Information representing the time or work necessary to make returned equipment ready for its next rental, potentially including inspection, cleaning, refueling, or maintenance.

core_objects.name: Estimated Ready Time
core_objects.formula: Expected Return Time + Required Turnaround Time
core_objects.usage: Conflict detection for a downstream reservation must evaluate this value against the downstream reservation's pickup time, rather than raw Expected Return Time alone.
core_objects.unresolved: How Required Turnaround Time itself is determined (fixed value / varies by equipment type or condition / computed estimate) remains UNRESOLVED.

relationships.subject: reservation
statements: requests an Equipment item or equipment type

relationships.subject: inspection
statements: is performed or confirmed by a human actor
may be assisted by the Operations Agent

relationships.subject: agent-action
statements: is triggered by product state, event, user intent, or detected condition
affects one or more product objects
produces an outcome or failure state

relationships.subject: approval
statements: is granted or rejected by an authorized human actor
should remain attributable to the approving actor

relationships.subject: derived-conflict-relationship
relationships.description: A potential conflict between an active Rental and a downstream Reservation for the same Equipment or equipment type is represented as a derived/computed relationship, evaluated at prediction time — not persisted as a new core ontology relationship.
explicitly_declined: a permanent Rental -> downstream Reservation relationship
a complete Reservation state model, solely for Feature 001
relationships.note: Whether either becomes necessary will be revisited if future implementation analysis demonstrates the need.

rental_states.note: This is not yet an exhaustive or implementation-ready state machine.

equipment_states.unresolved: The relationship between operational availability, safety status, reservation assignment, and maintenance status.

ontology_layering_note.description: The Product Ontology, Agent Capability model (context/product.md §3), and Interaction Primitives (context/behaviors.md) are three distinct layers. Finding and Prepared Action are interaction primitives, not Core Objects of this ontology, even though they carry their own identifiers (findingId, preparedActionId) in context/components.md. Approval is the one exception: it is both a Core Object (see approval entry above) and an interaction primitive, viewed from two angles.
